assignment: Each case/seed block runs all five methods on one fixed worker; 25 blocks per case per worker. Randomized method order. Fresh process and learner for every trial.
cpu_topology: Each worker gets one P core with both SMT threads and two E cores; no logical CPU is shared across workers. Validated for yoriyuki-raytrek i9-14900KF.
timing_caveat: Wall time under concurrent server load, not isolated latency. Affinity is fixed, but other workers and tail-end idle slots affect contention; report worker and timestamps and do not mix old Mac/server measurements. Four assigned logical CPUs do not imply fourfold acceleration.
